subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Inept
solution: The correct answer is **"Skilful."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Inept"** means lacking skill or ability. (कोई काम अच्‍छे ढंग से करने में असमर्थ; दक्षताहीन, अकुशल) • **Example**: *She is totally **inept**__ at dealing with people.* • **"Skilful"** is the opposite of **"inept."** • **"Skilful" **means having or showing skill or expertise. ((व्‍यक्ति) कोई काम करने में निपुण; कुशल) __ • **Example**: *She is a **skilful**__ painter.* • The correct answer is Option 3. __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Adorable** means lovable or cute. ((बच्‍चों या पशुओं के लिए प्रयुक्त) स्‍नेह की भावना जगाने वाला; मनमोहक) • **Kind** means having a friendly or generous nature. (समान गुणों वाले व्यक्तियों का समूह; वर्ग) • **Elegant** means graceful and stylish in appearance or manner. (आकर्षक, रमणीक) 45:Tcd9, The correct answer is **"The letter will be posted by the peon."**
